CAL.description: The primary viticultural powerhouse of the United States, covering the state of California.

HAW.description: The insular viticultural region of the Hawaiian islands.

MID.description: The continental heartland including key wine-producing states such as Missouri, Michigan, Ohio, and Illinois.

NOR.description: The historical and eastern seaboard corridor centered around New York and Pennsylvania.

PNW.description: The cool-climate northern coastal basin covering Washington, Oregon, and Idaho.
